You don't need PHP, Node.js, or any server-side logic — simply point your form's `action` attribute to your unique MyFormCapture endpoint. --- ## What you'll build In this guide, you will create a standard contact form with three inputs: 1. **Name** (``) 2. **Email address** (``) 3. **Message** (``) When visitors submit this form on your website, MyFormCapture captures the submission, runs spam filtering, sends you an email notification, and forwards the data to any configured webhooks. --- ## File structure Place your HTML form inside your standard website project directory:

Contact Our Team

Fill out the form below and we will get back to you shortly.

`} /> --- ## Step-by-step explanation
1

Set the Form Action URL

The action attribute points directly to your unique MyFormCapture endpoint. Each form in your dashboard receives a dedicated UUID such as https://myformcapture.com/f/your-form-uuid.

2

Specify the POST Method

Always configure method="POST". MyFormCapture processes incoming form data over secure HTTPS POST requests.

3

Assign Descriptive Input Names

MyFormCapture maps submission columns directly from each input's name attribute (e.g. name="name", name="email", name="message"). Make sure each field has a unique name.

4

Add Custom Redirect & Spam Prevention

Adding <input type="hidden" name="_next" value="https://..."> automatically redirects users back to your custom thank-you page. Adding name="_gotcha" acts as a silent honeypot that catches automated spam bots.

---
Illustrative Demo Endpoint The endpoint https://myformcapture.com/f/demo-form-uuid is an illustrative placeholder. In your actual production deployment, replace this placeholder with your authentic form endpoint from your MyFormCapture console.
